fields.summary: Refactor database connection pooling to use pg-pool
fields.description:
Our current database connection management creates a new connection for each request, leading to connection exhaustion under load. We should refactor to use a proper connection pool.

This is tracked as a tech-debt item following the production incident in Q4 2023.

comments.body: After the Q4 incident, this is now urgent. We saw 300+ connection exhaustion errors.
